knownDiscrepancies.why: `gcloud run services list --format=json` embeds the proxy's INTERLOCK_SIGNING_KEY_PEM (an Ed25519 private key) verbatim in the service env. Those dumps were taken with plain gcloud before the redaction adapter existed and were removed rather than committed. Every frame in this package went through the hardened path, whose redaction covers private-key blocks; none of them contain key material. The project has since been deleted, so the key is dead either way.
